script_text: Stop, Sagittarius: your fire sign is pushed into a money-and-contract decision right now. As the Archer, ruled by Jupiter, you’re feeling Mars in Taurus sextile Pluto in Aquarius, activating your 6th House of Work and 3rd House of Contracts. The Moon in Taurus reinforces your 6th House, making workload and body signals impossible to ignore. Venus is separating from its conjunction with Jupiter in Cancer, your 8th House of Shared Resources, so a talk about debt, taxes, commission, or a partner’s money carries weight. In love, a loyal, sensual person may test your boundaries; if you’re taken, avoid making intimacy sound like a repayment plan. Career and money-wise, your 6th House is loud: a coworker, client, or routine reveals a paid opening, while the 3rd House points to a message, invoice, or negotiation you can use. Avoid signing before the numbers are verified. Follow for tomorrow’s reading.
